summary.short: Draft Jiangsu provincial regulation to promote the AI industry in Jiangsu. It covers government coordination, public data and high-quality datasets, computing infrastructure and data-centre power coordination, sector applications, safety and filing duties for AI service providers, ethics committees, and state support. The effective date is blank in the draft.
summary.long: The draft regulation applies to activities that promote the AI industry within Jiangsu Province (Art. 2). Provincial and municipal governments and designated departments coordinate industry development, with the data authority responsible for public data resources and high-quality datasets (Arts. 4-5, 11-12). It provides for unified computing infrastructure and scheduling, a public computing-sharing mechanism, and coordination between data-centre power use and grid operators, with encouragement of green power purchases (Arts. 14-16). It promotes AI in manufacturing, agriculture, medicine, transport, education, public services and government governance (Arts. 35-45). AI service providers must complete security assessments and filings under national rules and label AI-generated content (Art. 47). Research and development entities must establish ethics committees (Art. 49). The regulation allows sandbox and inclusive supervision (Art. 46), and provides for special funds, computing and token vouchers, and financing support (Arts. 52-53). Penalties are left to existing law, and officials are liable for dereliction of duty (Art. 62). The effective date is blank (Art. 63).

notes: Draft (草案) dated 2026-07-31 in the header; not adopted. No specific instrument is named, so no relation rows are coded. Generic references only: '有关法律、行政法规' (Art. 1), '國家有关规定' (Arts. 5, 47), 'the laws, regulations and rules' on network, data, personal information and generative AI services (Art. 48), and '法律、法规已有处罚规定的，从其规定' (Art. 62). Entry-into-force date is blank in Art. 63 ('自 年 月 日起施行'). The draft sets no penalty amounts; Art. 62 defers to existing laws and regulations.

thresholds.note: The operative provisions contain no numeric cutoffs that change legal treatment. Enterprise size categories (中小企业, 专精特新中小企业, 专精特新“小巨人”企业 in Art. 26) are named without numeric criteria, and the electricity-cost language in Art. 16 has no figures. Penalties are delegated to other laws (Art. 62). The effective date in Art. 63 is blank in this draft.
